name: disrobe
description: Deobfuscate, decompile, and unpack almost anything by driving the disrobe CLI from inside Binary Ninja.
longdescription: Registers Binary Ninja plugin commands under the `disrobe` menu that run disrobe subcommands on the open file and print the recovered output to the Binary Ninja log. Drives the real disrobe binary; no placeholder bodies.

license.name: Elastic-2.0
license.text: Elastic License 2.0. See the disrobe repository LICENSE for terms.

installinstructions.Linux: Copy this directory into ~/.binaryninja/plugins/disrobe and restart Binary Ninja.
installinstructions.Darwin: Copy this directory into ~/Library/Application Support/Binary Ninja/plugins/disrobe and restart Binary Ninja.
installinstructions.Windows: Copy this directory into %APPDATA%\Binary Ninja\plugins\disrobe and restart Binary Ninja.

author: disrobe
menupath: disrobe \ Auto: run full deobfuscation pipeline
disrobe \ Strings: extract and deobfuscate strings
disrobe \ IOC: extract indicators of compromise
disrobe \ Identify: compiler / packer / protector fingerprint
